_about: Per ground: lat/lon of the model's origin (model x east, -z north) and ge_alt, Google Earth's own turf height (m above sea level, status bar). 'source' says where each came from. Origins marked 'shape audit' were solved by lining the model up on a straight-down GE shot (register), +-1 m where 'turn_deg' is near 0; re-run `register` after any model change. A large turn_deg means the model is not north-up against Google Earth (or the lining-up was ambiguous): read the note.
